svg.title: StyleGAN2 generator revisions
svg.desc: (a) StyleGAN: blocks at 4×4 and 8×8 built from Const 4×4×512 or Upsample, Conv 3×3, noise inputs B added (⊕) and AdaIN layers driven by styles A. (b) StyleGAN detailed: AdaIN split into Norm mean/std and Mod mean/std; each style block has Mod mean/std (from A), Conv 3×3 with weights w, bias b and noise B added, then Norm mean/std; c1 is the constant input. (c) Revised architecture: only std is modulated and normalized (Mod std, Norm std), and bias b and noise B are added outside the style block. (d) Weight demodulation: Mod and Demod act on the conv weights w directly (Mod from A, then Demod) before Conv 3×3; bias and noise added after each block.
